# Every committed diagram, regenerated by `mvn verify` (code-karta-cli/pom.xml, execution
# gen-diagrams) and by `./gradlew :code-karta-cli:generateDiagrams`, both through
#   java -jar code-karta-cli-*-all.jar --batch code-karta-cli/diagrams.txt
# from the repository root. One line per command line, run in order in one JVM.
#
# This file is the single list (#279). Two hand-kept copies, one per build, drifted apart: seven
# committed diagrams went stale while one list left them out (#249). A diagram added here is
# regenerated by both builds, and CI's "generated output differs" step fails until it is committed.

# 1. Module diagram: example shipping system
--input example-shipping-system/src/main/java/module-info.java --output docs/diagrams

# 2. Class diagram: core IR model
--input code-karta-core/src/main/java/se/deversity/codekarta/core/model --output docs/diagrams

# 3. Exception-flow sequence: CLI entry point
--input code-karta-cli/src/main/java/se/deversity/codekarta/cli/KartaCli.java --output docs/diagrams

# 4. Call-sequence only: demonstrates --sequence-only
--input code-karta-input/src/main/java/se/deversity/codekarta/input/parser/CallSequenceParser.java --output docs/diagrams --sequence-only

# 5. Multi-file stitched sequence: the input parsers, with ELK layout
--input code-karta-input/src/main/java/se/deversity/codekarta/input --output docs/diagrams --sequence-only --layout elk

# 6. State machine: KartaCli pipeline stages
--input code-karta-cli/src/main/java/se/deversity/codekarta/cli/KartaCli.java --state-machine --output docs/diagrams

# 7. Example state machine: switch-case transitions
--input example-shipping-system/src/main/java/com/karta/shipping/state/ShipmentLifecycle.java --state-machine --output example-shipping-system/diagrams

# 8. Example state machine: transition(from, to, event) DSL
--input example-shipping-system/src/main/java/com/karta/shipping/state/PaymentWorkflow.java --state-machine --output example-shipping-system/diagrams

# 9. Example state machine: linear state assignments
--input example-shipping-system/src/main/java/com/karta/shipping/state/InventoryReservation.java --state-machine --output example-shipping-system/diagrams

# 10. Example module diagram
--input example-shipping-system/src/main/java/module-info.java --output example-shipping-system/diagrams

# 11. Example class diagram: domain package
--input example-shipping-system/src/main/java/com/karta/shipping/domain --output example-shipping-system/diagrams

# 12. Example exception-flow sequence
--input example-shipping-system/src/main/java/com/karta/shipping/core/OrderProcessor.java --output example-shipping-system/diagrams

# 13. The viewer over docs/diagrams. Last, so it indexes every SVG above.
--output docs/diagrams --viewer
